evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative command directed at a subordinate system enacts authority-ranking: the speaker issues a deletion order without consultation or reciprocity.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Bare imperative verb enacts hierarchical command — the speaker directs erasure of information with no negotiation or exchange framing.
